response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and broad experience across languages and architectures, but lacks explicit evidence of executive leadership, UML expertise, IT security/compliance experience, and German proficiency (only 'Basic' listed), which are critical for this Head of Development role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven full-stack expertise across diverse tech stacks (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript, Linux)
Demonstrated mentorship and workshop leadership in testing, CI/CD, and web internals
concerns: German language proficiency listed as 'Basic' — fails C1 requirement
No clear evidence of architectural leadership, UML modeling, or security/compliance experience
Lacks documented team management or project oversight at executive level
